title: Step 2 — converge near-gray neutrals onto tokens (intentional visual delta)
description:
Follow-up split out of LIN-493 (token-wiring close-out). LIN-493 finished the **no-op exact-match** wiring; what remains is the **value-changing** convergence it explicitly deferred, because these hexes are *close but not equal* to a token and wiring them produces a (small, intended) visual delta — out of scope for the no-visual-change Step 1.

**Residual near-gray usage sites at HEAD (public/\*.css):**

* `#e0e0e0` ×17 — closest token `--border (#ddd)`
* `#f0f0f0` ×5, `#e8e8e8` ×3, `#e2e2e2` ×3 — near `--fg-vdim`/`--border`
* `#ccc` ×3, `#bbb` ×3 — near `--border`/`--fg-dim`

**Do:** decide per-site whether to snap onto the nearest existing neutral token (accepting the delta) or to introduce a new neutral token for the recurring value (e.g. `#e0e0e0`), then re-baseline the affected visual specs deliberately.

**Explicitly NOT in scope here:** chromatic view-specific one-offs (`#2c3e50`, `#e67e22`, `#ea7317`, `#d97706`, `#c0392b`, `#1d4ed8`, …) — those are genuine palette colors with no matching token and stay as-is unless/until a palette-token effort is opened.

Keep `:root` in `public/style.css` as the source of token values. Guard with the LIN-492 visual baselines, re-baselining intentionally where the delta is accepted.

---

## Research findings (Step 2 — ready to implement)

**Scope confirmed:** all residual near-grays live only in `public/swim.css` + `public/swipe.css`; inventory matches at HEAD.

**Snap to existing tokens (accept small delta):**

* `#e0e0e0` ×17 (borders) → `var(--border)`
* `#e2e2e2` ×3 (borders) → `var(--border)`
* `#e8e8e8` ×3 (swipe meta-card borders) → `var(--border)`
* `#f0f0f0` ×4 (subtle dividers, border-top/bottom) → `var(--fg-vdim)`

**New token (recurring value, no existing home):**

* `#bbb` ×3 (`state-unstarted` accent + sequential connector) → introduce `--fg-mid: #bbb` in all 3 theme blocks. Do NOT snap to `--border` (collapses unstarted vs backlog).

**Judgement calls:**

* `#ccc` ×3 (hover/focus border-color) → add `--border-strong: #ccc` to preserve hover emphasis, OR accept snap to `--border`.
* `#f0f0f0` ×1 (`.swipe-prompt-btn:active` bg) → lowest priority; accept `--bg-muted` (loses pressed step) or add `--bg-pressed`.

**Open Q3:** `#e0e0e0` is NOT a new-token case — it's border-only, snap to `--border`. The genuine new-token value is `#bbb`.

**Theme note:** these hexes are currently theme-invariant (latent bug); tokenizing makes swim/swipe respond to dark/amber. Light delta tiny; dark/amber delta larger but corrective. New tokens need dark+amber values too.

**Re-baseline (LIN-492, light-theme only, maker specs don't assert — regenerate + commit PNGs):**
`tests/screenshots/swim/`, `swim-vertical/`, `swim-flow/`, `swim-blocking/` (swim.css); `tests/screenshots/pages/swipe-{desktop,mobile}.png` (swipe.css). Command: `npx playwright test --config=playwright.visual.config.js <spec>`.

**Surface assessment:** lands cleanly, no refactor required; changes localized to two stylesheets + additive token lines in `:root`/dark/amber.

**Out of scope (chromatic one-offs, leave as-is):** `#c0392b`, `#e67e22`, `#2c3e50`, `#ea7317`, `#d97706`, `#1d4ed8`.

## Research — Step 2 neutral convergence (LIN-510)

**Staleness check:** ticket is accurate at HEAD. Re-counted every raw value in `public/*.css` and the inventory matches exactly (`#e0e0e0`×17, `#f0f0f0`×5, `#e8e8e8`×3, `#e2e2e2`×3, `#ccc`×3, `#bbb`×3). All sites are confined to **`public/swim.css` + `public/swipe.css`** only — no other CSS, no JS, no render files. `git log` since createdAt shows token-wiring work (LIN-499/500) but nothing that invalidated this inventory.

### Existing neutral tokens (`:root`, style.css L18–41; mirrored in dark L90–105 + amber L117–132)
`--bg #fff` · `--bg-muted #f8f9fa` · `--fg #1a1a1a` · `--fg-dim #666` · `--fg-vdim #eee` (structural/divider) · `--border #ddd` · `--border-subtle rgba(0,0,0,.08)`

### Per-site decision

**Bucket A — snap to an existing token (27 sites, 4 values), accept the small intended delta:**
| raw | × | role | → token | Δ/channel |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `#e0e0e0` | 17 | hairline borders (swim+swipe) | `var(--border)` | 3 |
| `#e2e2e2` | 3 | borders (swim-flow fcard) | `var(--border)` | 5 |
| `#e8e8e8` | 3 | swipe meta-card borders (on `--bg-muted`) | `var(--border)` | 11 |
| `#f0f0f0` | 4 | subtle section dividers (border-top/bottom) | `var(--fg-vdim)` | 2 |

**Bucket B — do NOT naive-snap (force-snapping collapses an intentional distinction); new token candidates:**
| raw | × | role | recommendation |
|---|---|---|---|
| `#bbb` | 3 | `state-unstarted` left/top accent (×2, swim L220/L711) + sequential connector `stroke` (×1, swim L469) | **NEW `--fg-mid: #bbb`** — backlog already uses `var(--border)` (L712); snapping unstarted→--border erases unstarted-vs-backlog. No existing token sits at ~187. Strongest recurring-value case. |
| `#ccc` | 3 | hover/focus `border-color` (swim-box:hover L212, swipe-arrow:hover, swipe-prompt-btn:hover) | hover border is deliberately *darker* than rest; once rest→`--border`, snapping hover→`--border` kills the hover affordance → **NEW `--border-strong: #ccc`**, or knowingly accept the loss |
| `#f0f0f0` | 1 | `.swipe-prompt-btn:active` pressed `background` | singleton, not recurring; same button's `:hover` already uses `--bg-muted`, so snapping active→--bg-muted loses the pressed step. Lowest priority — accept, or tiny `--bg-pressed`. |

### Open question #3 — is `#e0e0e0` a new token? **No.** It is purely a border value 3/channel from `--border` and used only as a border → snap to `var(--border)`. The ticket parenthetical was illustrative. The value that genuinely earns a new token is `#bbb` (a semantic state accent with no existing home), and arguably `#ccc` (a missing 'strong border' emphasis tier).

### Theme dimension — the real win AND the real risk
These raw hexes are **theme-invariant**: they stay light-gray under the dark/amber themes today (latent bug — `--border`/`--fg-vdim` have dark+amber variants). Tokenizing makes them theme-responsive. So light-theme delta is tiny (Δ2–11); dark/amber delta is large but *corrective*. Any NEW token (`--fg-mid`, `--border-strong`) MUST be defined in all three theme blocks.

### Visual baselines to re-baseline (LIN-492)
Baselines are committed reference PNGs under `tests/screenshots/` produced by maker specs that **do not assert** (they only write PNGs — there is no failing CI gate; the guard is human review of the committed PNG diff). Regenerate via `npx playwright test --config=playwright.visual.config.js <spec>` and commit the changed PNGs:
- **swim.css** → `tests/screenshots/swim/` (swim-screenshots), `swim-vertical/` (swim-vertical), `swim-flow/` (swim-flow — the `#e2e2e2` fcards), `swim-blocking/` (swim-blocking)
- **swipe.css** → `tests/screenshots/pages/swipe-desktop.png` + `swipe-mobile.png` (pages-screenshots, 'Swipe page')
- Baselines are **light-theme only** (no spec switches theme) → re-baseline covers light only; the dark/amber improvement ships unguarded by visuals (acceptable, but state it in the PR).

### Scope boundary — confirmed
Chromatic one-offs stay as-is: `#c0392b` (swipe meta-blocks L251–252), `#e67e22` (swim blocked accent L713), `#2c3e50`/`#ea7317`/`#d97706`/`#1d4ed8`, etc. All are genuine non-gray palette colors with no neutral token → **out of scope** unless a separate palette-token effort opens.

### Surface assessment
**Lands cleanly — no refactor required.** Change is localized to two stylesheets + (if new tokens chosen) an additive 1–2 lines in each of the three `:root` theme blocks. No new seam, no consumer, no structural change. New tokens are additive, not a prerequisite refactor. Bucket A is mechanical; the only judgement calls are the three Bucket-B sites (recommend: add `--fg-mid` for `#bbb`; decide `--border-strong` for `#ccc` vs accept; treat the single `#f0f0f0` bg as lowest priority).

### Minimum reliable path for implementation
1. Bucket A: replace the 27 sites with `var(--border)` / `var(--fg-vdim)` as tabled.
2. Add `--fg-mid: #bbb` to all 3 theme blocks; point the `#bbb` sites at it (pick theme-appropriate dark/amber values).
3. Decide `#ccc`: add `--border-strong` (preserves hover) or snap to `--border` (accept). Handle the lone `#f0f0f0` background last.
4. Regenerate the five baseline families above; commit PNGs; eyeball the diffs for the intended deltas.

## Step 2 implemented — PR [#516](https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/516) (commit `0ba8f61`)

Converged the residual near-gray neutrals in `public/swim.css` + `public/swipe.css` onto tokens, accepting the intended small visual delta.

**Bucket A (snap to existing tokens):**
- `#e0e0e0`×17, `#e2e2e2`×3, `#e8e8e8`×3 → `var(--border)`
- `#f0f0f0`×4 subtle dividers → `var(--fg-vdim)`

**New tokens (defined in all 3 theme blocks: `:root`/dark/amber):**
- `--fg-mid` (`#bbb` light) for `state-unstarted` accent + sequential connector — kept distinct from `--border` so unstarted ≠ backlog.
- `--border-strong` (`#ccc` light) for hover/focus border emphasis — preserves the deliberately-darker hover.

**Judgement calls resolved:**
- `#ccc` → new `--border-strong` (preserves hover affordance) rather than naive snap to `--border`.
- lone `#f0f0f0` `.swipe-prompt-btn:active` bg → folded into `var(--bg-muted)` (no one-use `--bg-pressed` token).

**Out of scope, untouched:** chromatic one-offs (`#c0392b`, `#e67e22`, `#ea7317`, `#d97706`, `#1d4ed8`, `#9ca3af`, …).

**Re-baselined (LIN-492, light-theme only):** `tests/screenshots/swim/`, `swim-vertical/`, `swim-flow/`, `swim-blocking/`, `pages/swipe-{desktop,mobile}.png`, and `pages/styleguide-{desktop,mobile}.png`. Non-target page PNGs regenerated by the shared maker spec were reverted to keep the re-baseline intentional. Dark/amber ship without screenshot coverage (no spec switches theme) — these surfaces were theme-invariant before (latent bug); the dark/amber delta is corrective.

**Out-of-ticket-but-necessary:** registered the two new tokens in the `/styleguide` swatch grid (`lib/render-styleguide.js`) to satisfy the "every `:root` token is exercised" unit test. All 1856 unit tests pass.

Staleness check: ticket accurate at HEAD — re-counted every value, inventory matched exactly. Leaving In Progress pending PR review + CI green.

## Review — LIN-510 Step 2 (neutral-token convergence) — ⚠️ Request Changes (code is approve-ready; the baselines aren't)

**PR [#516](https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/516) · commit `0ba8f61` · CI: green (but see caveat).**

### Code — APPROVE
The CSS/token convergence is correct, clean, and exactly matches the recorded plan:
- **Bucket A** snaps as tabled: `#e0e0e0`×17 / `#e2e2e2`×3 / `#e8e8e8`×3 → `var(--border)`; `#f0f0f0`×4 dividers → `var(--fg-vdim)`.
- **New tokens** `--fg-mid` (`#bbb`) and `--border-strong` (`#ccc`) defined in **all three** theme blocks (`:root`/dark/amber) with sensible dark/amber values, and registered in the `/styleguide` swatch grid — so `--fg-mid` stays distinct from `--border` (unstarted ≠ backlog) and `--border-strong` preserves hover emphasis, as required.
- Singleton `.swipe-prompt-btn:active` bg folded into `var(--bg-muted)` (no one-off `--bg-pressed`), per the constraint.
- Chromatic one-offs (`#c0392b`, `#e67e22`, `#9ca3af`, `#d97706`, `#1d4ed8`, …) left untouched.

### Cross-cutting check — CLEAN
- **Zero** residual near-gray literals remain in `public/swim.css` / `public/swipe.css`.
- **No sibling instances** of the same pattern elsewhere: grep across all `public/*.css` finds no other `#e0e0e0`/`#e8e8e8`/`#e2e2e2`/`#bbb`/`#ccc`/`#f0f0f0` literals (only the two new token *definitions* in `style.css`). Nothing left to spin out.
- Staleness check: inventory accurate at HEAD; no conflicting changes to the referenced paths since createdAt.

### Blocker — the swim-blocking re-baseline does NOT match the described delta
The `tests/screenshots/swim-blocking/*` baselines did not change by a "tiny Δ2–11/channel" color amount — they changed **dimensions**: `1280×838` → `1280×1966` (~2.3× taller), flipping from a **horizontal** lane layout to the **flow** layout with many more cards (TODO/BACKLOG sections). A neutral-color token swap cannot change page height or orientation.

**Root cause (verified):** the swim default layout was switched to `flow` (`89f53e4` "make flow the default layout", `4ba6e23`, `0637828`, …) *after* these baselines were last generated (`fd85d29`, LIN-303). The `swim-blocking` spec never pins orientation, so it renders the default — which silently drifted horizontal→flow. The main-branch `swim-blocking` baselines were therefore **already stale** before LIN-510; this re-baseline is the first regeneration since, so it absorbs all that accumulated, unrelated UI drift under the neutral-token banner.

**Why it matters:** these maker specs do **not assert** — green CI proves nothing about the visuals; the only guard is human review of the committed PNG diff. Committing a horizontal→flow layout overhaul inside a PR whose comment says "tiny light-theme delta" defeats that guard: the real color delta is invisible, and a large UI change rides in unreviewed. (The other families — `swim/`, `swim-vertical/`, `swim-flow/`, `swipe-*` — show only the modest expected delta; `swim-blocking` is the outlier precisely because it doesn't pin orientation.)

### Required before merge (cheap)
1. **Acknowledge the drift in the PR/commit**: the `swim-blocking` baselines also fold in a pre-existing horizontal→flow default-layout change (stale since `fd85d29`), and confirm the new flow render is the intended current behavior. Then the committed delta is honest and a reviewer can knowingly accept it. (Splitting the stale-baseline refresh into its own commit would be cleaner but is optional — the drift is corrective.)
2. **Follow-up (record, don't expand):** the `swim-blocking` spec should pin `orientation` (or add explicit flow coverage) so its baselines stop silently tracking default-layout flips. Worth a small ticket.

### Verdict
**Request Changes — not safe to merge as-is.** The code change is correct and approve-ready; the objection is solely that the `swim-blocking` screenshot baselines do not represent the delta the ticket claims and bypass the project's visual-review guard. Once #1 above is addressed (and #2 logged), this is a clean merge.

_Not merging / not marking Done, per workflow._
